text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets Saudi prince Nawaf Ibn Abdulaziz in Rabat.
- Crown Prince Sidi Mohammed represents Morocco at the anniversary of U.S. National Symphony Ball in Washington. He also held talks with U.S. foreign affairs officials.
- Euro-Mediterranean businessmen meeting in Marrakesh decide to set up a North African business association. The new association includes Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Egypt and later Mauritania.
- France presents its condolences to Rabat after death of Moroccan student Mohamed Ben Chaou in Paris. Chaou died from wounds caused by bomb blast on train in Paris last week.
- The European Union grants Morocco a $37.5 million loan for road projects in the northern provinces.

- ONA Group leader Fouad Filali says businessmen from Gulf countries are interested in investing in Morocco. ONA Group is Morocco's largest private conglomerate which holds stakes in more than 100 companies.
